Dominance is rarer than talent, and harder to keep. {winner} kept it throughout.

pullquote.text: Winning is one thing, but this was something closer to ownership.

The totals are filed and the verdict is clear. Let the champion enjoy it.

Next time the scales may swing the other way. That is how rivalries stay alive.

pullquote.text: The best rivals push the champion to look even better.

stories.standfirst: Pick up the cabinet key, because {winnerClub} is going to need the whole shelf after a Showdown this commanding.
paragraphs: There is a particular sound a trophy makes when it is set down with confidence. {winner} has finished {seasonsTotal} seasons so far ahead of {loser} that the Showdown felt decided long before the final page.

A win this big is a memory the whole club can share.

pullquote.text: Some wins sneak up on you, and others walk in through the front door.

stories.standfirst: Look back over all the seasons and the shape is unmistakable, with {winner} always a little further ahead.
paragraphs: A long Showdown has a rhythm, and {winner} set it. From the opening season to the last, {winnerClub} kept gathering the points that mattered, and by the end the lead over {loser} had grown to {margin}.
Single seasons can be argued over for years. The complete picture cannot, because {winnerPoints} against {loserPoints} across {seasonsTotal} seasons leaves very little to argue about.
This is how champions are made, quietly and repeatedly, until the result looks inevitable.

pullquote.text: A complete record is the only argument that never loses.

stories.standfirst: Down at {winnerClub} the mood is quietly regal, and the Showdown trophy has found a home it intends to keep.
paragraphs: A comfortable victory is a different animal from a narrow one. {winner} has won the Showdown by {margin}, and the sense around {winnerClub} is of a job done thoroughly rather than a battle narrowly survived.
{loser} and {loserClub} carry on with their own plans, and a dominant finish for a rival does not close the book on them. It simply tells them where the standard now sits.
The winning club can now enjoy the calm of a decision that nobody doubts.

pullquote.text: A comfortable win is a thousand small good decisions in a row.

stories.standfirst: The Showdown is over, and the verdict is a wide and happy one for {winner}, who led for most of the way.
paragraphs: The Gazette records, with pleasure, that {winner} has won the Showdown by a distance. With {winnerPoints} against {loserPoints}, the gap of {margin} makes the story a short one to tell.

Well played, both of you. One of you simply played a little better.

pullquote.text: A great win needs no footnote and no explanation.
